scope: Small precise pattern inventory in live src/CardGame.Core C# files; src C# assignment cross-check. No historical full-text scan, build, test, source edit, Full, release or commit.

sites.expression: frame = frame with { InstructionIndex = frame.InstructionIndex - 1, ReexecuteParticipantInstruction = false };
sites.classification: Existing synchronous atomic rewind consumed by the executor; not a defect.
sites.before_rewind: The host returns only an active topmost ProgramSkillFrame. Post-instruction windows are attempted first; live actor/program/hash and skill-instance qualification then run. The selected-card payment barrier returns before rewind if unpaid child work remains.
sites.after_rewind: The repeat flag is cleared with decrement. Cursor bounds, batch cleanup and terminal checks follow. The selected instruction cursor is incremented and stored before condition evaluation and handler invocation. There is no child start or command-return path between a valid repeat rewind and recommit, except terminal completion or throw for invalid state.
sites.publication_boundary: ProgramSkillHost.UpdateFrame delegates to ReplaceRuntimeTop. ReplaceRuntimeTop checks active frame identity and only calls _resolutionStack.Replace(next); it does not PublishState, queue rule facts or expose a child window.

excluded_false_positives: InstructionIndex == 0 guards, plan.Instructions[frame.InstructionIndex - 1] paused-instruction indexing, and receipt.InstructionIndex == frame.InstructionIndex - 1 comparisons are reads/comparisons, not cursor writes. The =(?!=) assignment guard excludes equality matches. No such read was classified as a rewind bug.
scope_limit: The result is a live inventory of direct InstructionIndex decrement and Math.Max variants. It is not a proof about all possible arithmetic aliases, generated code or every repeat mechanism, and no new runtime risk was reproduced.

next_focused_fixture_recommendation.current_action: No new fixture is required by this inventory because there is no remaining suspicious pre-child write. Existing first Strategic before/after damage child regression and source-loss/condition-change batch checks already cover the repaired case; avoid duplicating them.
existing_filters: skill executor retires strategic damage batches
program continuation registration preserves ordered typed returns
next_focused_fixture_recommendation.if_a_new_repeat_handler_is_later_changed: Use a real loader fixture with the repeating operation as effects[0], freeze a nontrivial participant suffix, and pause a real cards-moved or HP-change child through its native prompt. Assert parent committed cursor=1 and its exact typed draft/remaining suffix during the child; round-trip cold checkpoint JSON before and after its answer. Verify committed payment/event/RNG prefix, source-loss cancellation and live condition change only if that handler permits them; finish the parent and assert each participant/payment once and the following operation once. Reuse the existing filtered runner, and only add the uncovered behavior.

verification_boundary: No runtime or build verification was run by this reviewer. Root separately reported focused 28 Core checks passing and is running routine verification; this report does not independently confirm that execution.
